 Print AI-generated image for representation purpose only Samsung's upcoming smartphone lineup is expected to include its next Galaxy S27 lineup in the early 2027. The series may include the standard Samsung Galaxy S27, Samsung Galaxy S27 Plus, Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra. The upcoming smartphones are tipped to bring upgrades in performance, display technology, cameras and battery capacity. According to leaks and rumours, the Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27 Plus have reportedly appeared on India's Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification database, hinting at their planned launch in the country.. Here is a look at the upcoming Samsung phones expected to launch in India. Samsung Galaxy S27
 The Samsung Galaxy S27 is expected to be the entry-level model in the upcoming flagship series. According to reports, the Gaalxy S27 could feature a 6.3-inch AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate. The handset may be powered by Samsung's Exynos 2700 chipset, although a Snapdragon processor could be used in some markets. The smartphone is tipped to come with up to 12GB RAM and 512GB of internal storage. For photography, it could feature a triple rear camera setup with a 50MP primary sensor, a 12MP ultra-wide camera and a 10MP telephoto lens. The phone may also include a 12MP front camera. Samsung Galaxy S27 is expected to run Android 17 with Samsung's One UI interface. It could pack a 4,400mAh battery with 25W wired charging support. Key Specifications (Expected) RAM and Storage: Up to 12GB RAM; up to 512GB storage
 Display: 6.3-inch AMOLED, up to 144Hz
 Processor: Samsung Exynos 2700
 Rear Cameras: 50MP + 12MP ultra-wide + 10MP telephoto
 Front Camera: 12MP
 Battery: 4,400mAh, 25W charging
 Samsung Galaxy S27 price in India (Expected) The Samsung Galaxy S27 is expected to be priced between Rs 81,999 and Rs 94,990 in India, depending on the storage variant. The final price is likely to be announced at launch. Samsung Galaxy S27 Plus
 The Samsung Galaxy S27 Plus is expected to come with a larger display and battery than the standard Galaxy S27. The smartphone could feature a 6.7-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It may be powered by the Exynos 2700 chipset or a Snapdragon 8 Elite-series processor, depending on the market. The device is tipped to come with 12GB RAM and 256GB or 512GB storage options. In terms of cameras, the Galaxy S27 Plus may feature a 50MP primary camera with optical image stabilisation, a 12MP ultra-wide lens and a 10MP telephoto camera with 3x optical zoom. The front camera is expected to be a 12MP sensor. The smartphone could be backed by a 4,900mAh battery with 45W wired charging and 20W wireless charging support. It is also expected to run Android 17 with One UI. Key Specifications (Expected) RAM and Storage: 12GB RAM; 256GB and 512GB storage
 Display: 6.7-inch AMOLED, 120Hz
 Processor: Exynos 2700 or Snapdragon 8 Elite-series chipset
 Rear Cameras: 50MP + 12MP ultra-wide + 10MP telephoto
 Front Camera: 12MP
 Battery: 4,900mAh, 45W wired charging
 Samsung Galaxy S27 Plus price in India (Expected) The Samsung Galaxy S27 Plus could be priced around Rs 1,09,999 to Rs 1,29,999 in India. Some reports estimate its starting price at around Rs 1,29,999. Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro
 Samsung is reportedly planning to introduce a new Galaxy S27 Pro model in its upcoming flagship lineup. The smartphone is expected to sit between the Galaxy S27 Plus and Galaxy S27 Ultra. The Galaxy S27 Pro could feature a 6.5-inch AMOLED display with 120Hz refresh rate support and a Privacy Display feature. The device is tipped to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset and may run Android 17 with One UI. For cameras, the phone could include a 200MP primary sensor, a 50MP ultra-wide camera and a 10MP telephoto lens. It may also feature a 16MP front camera. The handset is expected to pack a 5,200mAh battery with 45W wired charging support. Key Specifications (Expected) RAM and Storage: 12GB RAM; 256GB storage
 Display: 6.5-inch AMOLED, 120Hz
 Processor: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6
 Rear Cameras: 200MP + 50MP ultra-wide + 10MP telephoto
 Front Camera: 16MP
 Battery: 5,200mAh, 45W charging
 Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro price in India (Expected) The Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro is expected to be priced between Rs 1,19,999 and Rs 1,29,990 in India. The phone's final pricing remains unconfirmed. Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra
 The Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra is expected to be the most premium smartphone in the upcoming Galaxy S27 series. Reports suggest that the device could feature a 6.9-inch AMOLED display with 2K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. The smartphone may be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. The Galaxy S27 Ultra is tipped to come with up to 16GB RAM and 1TB of storage. The phone could feature a redesigned rear camera system with a 200MP primary camera, a 50MP ultra-wide camera and a 50MP telephoto lens with 5x optical zoom. It may also include a 16MP front camera. The smartphone could pack a 5,700mAh battery with 60W wired charging and 25W wireless charging support. The device is also expected to retain S Pen support and run Android 17 with One UI. Key Specifications (Expected) RAM and Storage: 12GB and 16GB RAM; 256GB, 512GB and 1TB storage
 Display: 6.9-inch AMOLED, 2K resolution, 120Hz
 Processor: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
 Rear Cameras: 200MP + 50MP ultra-wide + 50MP telephoto
 Front Camera: 16MP
 Battery: 5,700mAh, 60W charging
 Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra price in India (Expected) The Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra is expected to start at around Rs 1,49,990 in India. Higher RAM and storage variants could cost more than Rs 1.7 lakh. Samsung Galaxy A38
 The Samsung Galaxy A38 is expected to be a mid-range smartphone in the company's upcoming Galaxy A series. According to the listed specifications, the handset could feature a 6.7-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate and Full HD+ resolution. The smartphone may be powered by an octa-core processor and come with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage. For photography, it could feature a triple rear camera setup with a 50MP primary sensor, an 8MP secondary camera and a 5MP third sensor. The phone may also include a 12MP front camera. The Samsung Galaxy A38 is expected to run Android 17. It could pack a 5,882mAh battery with 45W fast charging support. Key Specifications (Expected) RAM and Storage: 8GB RAM; 128GB storage
 Display: 6.7-inch Full HD+, 120Hz
 Processor: Octa-core processor
 Rear Cameras: 50MP + 8MP + 5MP
 Front Camera: 12MP
 Battery: 5,882mAh, 45W fast charging
 Samsung Galaxy A38 price in India (Expected) The Samsung Galaxy A38 is expected to be priced at Rs 47,990 in India. The final price is likely to be announced at launch. Samsung Galaxy A58 5G 
 The Samsung Galaxy A58 5G is expected to be an upcoming mid-range smartphone from Samsung. According to the listed specifications, the handset could be powered by an Exynos octa-core processor and come with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of internal storage. For photography, it may feature a triple rear camera setup with a 50MP primary sensor, a 12MP secondary camera and a 5MP third sensor. The smartphone could also include a 12MP front camera. The Samsung Galaxy A58 5G is listed with a 5,000mAh battery and 45W fast charging support. The phone is also expected to support 5G connectivity and NFC. Key Specifications (Expected) RAM and Storage: 8GB RAM; 256GB storage
 Processor: Exynos octa-core processor
 Rear Cameras: 50MP + 12MP + 5MP
 Front Camera: 12MP
 Battery: 5,000mAh, 45W fast charging
 Connectivity: 5G, NFC, eSIM
 Samsung Galaxy A58 5G price in India (Expected) The Samsung Galaxy A58 5G is expected to be priced at Rs 59,999 in India. The final price is likely to be announced at launch. Samsung Galaxy M37 5G 
 The Samsung Galaxy M37 5G is expected to be an upcoming smartphone in Samsung's Galaxy M series. According to reports, the handset could feature a 6.67-inch display with Full HD+ resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. The smartphone may be powered by an octa-core processor and come with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage. For photography, it could feature a triple rear camera setup with a 50MP primary sensor, an 8MP ultra-wide camera and a 2MP third sensor. The phone may also include a 16MP front camera. The Samsung Galaxy M37 5G is expected to run Android 16. It could pack a 5,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging support. The handset may also support hybrid memory card expansion of up to 1TB. Key Specifications (Expected) RAM and Storage: 8GB RAM; 128GB storage
 Display: 6.67-inch Full HD+, 120Hz
 Processor: Octa-core processor
 Rear Cameras: 50MP + 8MP ultra-wide + 2MP
 Front Camera: 16MP
 Battery: 5,000mAh, 45W fast charging
 Operating System: Android 16
 Memory Card: Hybrid slot, up to 1TB
